tranexamic-acid-pph.verified: citation chasing (Crossref) recovered all three PMIDs; all are double-blind RCTs (they pass our design gate)
tranexamic-acid-pph.not_pooled_because: OUTCOME mismatch: these are PPH-PREVENTION trials whose primary is peripartum blood loss (>=500-1000 mL) or bleeding in anaemia, not the topic's/comparator's 'death due to bleeding'. Reach ✓, design ✓, but they do not report the declared mortality-scale outcome to pool. Not a reach failure.

sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.verified: CV-death HR is reported (~0.80), but the extractor clause-bound it to the all-cause-death sentence
sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.not_pooled_because: ambiguous source attribution (all-cause vs CV-death sentence); and CV death is already a component of the pooled composite primary. Dropped rather than shipped ambiguous.

sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.verified: PIONEER-HF harm counts are in CT.gov structured results
sacubitril-valsartan-hfref.not_pooled_because: PIONEER-HF enrolled ACUTE decompensated HF with in-hospital initiation — out of scope for this chronic-HFrEF topic. Dropped.

corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.verified: 28-day mortality 6/16 vs 2/14, exact counts in the committed abstract
corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.not_pooled_because: n=30, stopped early; pooling it with RECOVERY's rate ratio produces a scale-mismatched IRR+OR combination and an uninformative interval (RR 1.30, 95% CI 0.0002-6827). Honest k=1 (RECOVERY) is preferred over an inflated, garbage k=2.

corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.verified: 28-day mortality is reported in each trial's full text (CoDEX 85/151 vs 91/148; Metcovid 72/194 vs 76/199)
corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.not_pooled_because: those counts are in the publisher full text (JAMA/OUP), not in our committed cached abstract. The PMC full-text adapter did not run in this build (source_status['PMC full text'] = NOT_RUN), so full-text access was not established and the counts cannot be self-verified against a committed source span; re-running the full-text adapter and committing those spans would allow pooling. Refused rather than pool numbers absent from committed evidence.

corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.verified: REMAP-CAP reports in-hospital mortality; CAPE-COVID reports day-21 mortality
corticosteroids-covid19-mortality.not_pooled_because: neither reports the declared 28-day all-cause mortality in its publication; the comparator (WHO REACT) used investigator-supplied 28-day data not present in the papers.

spironolactone-hfref-mortality.verified: all-cause mortality RR 0.87 (0.79-0.95), 478 vs 554 deaths, extracts cleanly
spironolactone-hfref-mortality.not_pooled_because: EPHESUS enrolled ACUTE post-myocardial-infarction LV dysfunction, which this topic's preregistered population_none excludes (chronic HFrEF only). A preregistered scope exclusion, not a miss; the comparator's inclusion of it is a scope difference.

colchicine-recurrent-pericarditis.verified: citation chasing (Crossref) RECOVERED both PMIDs from the comparator's reference list; FDA/EMA/registries could not reach them (pre-registry, generic drug)
colchicine-recurrent-pericarditis.not_pooled_because: REACH ✓ but SCREEN declines: both CORE and COPE (Imazio 2005) are OPEN-LABEL, and this topic preregisters double-blind (matching the pooled CORP/CORP-2/ICAP). A design-quality exclusion, not a reach failure — the comparator pooled open-label trials we do not.

colchicine-secondary-cv-prevention.not_pooled_because: the abstract reports 'events' (ambiguous recurrent-vs-patient) with no HR/CI and a broader composite (mortality+ACS+revascularisation+stroke) than a 3-point MACE; refused on ambiguity.
non-standard composite including decompensated heart failure; small, low-quality reporting; estimand mismatch.
this is a 30-day peri-PCI SECONDARY composite (the trial's primary is PCI-related myocardial injury); wrong timepoint/scope for secondary CV prevention.

omega3-cardiovascular-events.verified: citation chasing (Crossref, from the comparator's reference list) RECOVERED all four PMIDs; FDA/EMA + registries could not reach them
omega3-cardiovascular-events.not_pooled_because: REACH ✓ but SCREEN declines (a quality decision, not a search failure): JELIS and GISSI-Prevenzione are OPEN-LABEL and this topic preregisters double-blind; GISSI-HF is double-blind but its chronic-HF population/endpoint does not match. FDA/EMA/ISRCTN/EU-CTR/ICTRP cannot reach these pre-registry trials at all — only bibliographic reach does. The comparator's larger k includes open-label trials our criteria exclude.

iv-iron-hfref-hosp.not_pooled_because: these are RECURRENT-EVENT totals (rate ratios), not patients-with->=1-event; pooling them as a binomial 2x2 would over-count. Estimand mismatch with the count-based pool. (Until 2026-09-19 this row also named AFFIRM-AHF, whose recurrent total 217 vs 294 is still not pooled; its separate first-event participant count from its CT.gov row 'number of participants with at least one HF hospitalisation', 142/558 vs 178/550, HR 0.73, is the declared estimand and is admitted to the primary set (pool still SUPPRESSED: incompatible estimand classes) once the hyphen vocabulary fix lands, so that trial is no longer a refusal row.)
iv-iron-hfref-hosp.countersignature: OWED (Mahmood) -- re-adjudication prepared by the workshop 2026-09-19; not to be landed unsigned

iv-iron-hfref-hosp.not_pooled_because: FAIR-HF reports only PGA/NYHA (no HF-hospitalisation counts); EFFECT-HF is open-label with peak-VO2 as primary and no HF-hospitalisation result. Named data/outcome gaps.

corticosteroids-cap-mortality.not_pooled_because: reports 60-day mortality, not the declared 28-day; timepoint mismatch. Pooling mixed timepoints would be estimand-inconsistent.

metformin-pcos-ovulation.not_pooled_because: CROSSOVER design — per-phase completers, not parallel-group; the quoted counts are the CC-induced component only. Refused (unit-of-analysis).
reported as a continuous median (range) of per-woman ovulation rate with no parallel-group 2x2 and no per-arm n; not poolable as a binary rate.
Kocak: %s imply CYCLE not per-woman denominators and randomisation is unstated (Controlled Clinical Trial). Named scope/estimand exclusion.

Moll: treatment-NAIVE PCOS, clomifene citrate + metformin vs clomifene citrate + placebo -- a different population and a background-therapy contrast from the CC-resistant / metformin-vs-placebo set. Named scope/estimand exclusion.

disputed.reason: The claim graph (lane CG, integrated 2026-09-16) found this refusal and the primary pool asserting opposite policies for PMID 16769748: the row is pooled (64/111 vs 82/114) under the page's broader 'metformin vs placebo for ovulation' question while this registry names it a scope exclusion (background clomifene; treatment-naive). Neither is silently removed. The pool is unchanged pending a protocol decision; lane EN adds 'background_therapy' as a compatibility dimension so the contrast is disclosed per trial.
